title: A CONTROLLER OPENS THE ITEM MENU
why: From the trade audit of 2026-10-03: every cell menu (Equip, Offer to, keys, junk) opened on a right-click only, so a controller player could never offer an item from the stash. With nothing waiting, Y on the highlighted cell now opens that same menu at the cell; the menu was already a pad panel. The stash key bar names both.
now: On a controller, Y on a highlighted item opens its menu, so player 2 can offer, equip, bind and junk from the stash too.
